'''2008 Massachusetts Cash Tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG tournament with all-cash prizes, played on Saturday 16 August 2008 in Bridgewater, Massachusetts, in the church hall down the street from Scholar's Books and Games, 34 Central Square, with [[Michael Pistone]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-21864-315327">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315327#p315327 Event Details], Pistone84 (Michael Pistone), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192534/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21864.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Eric Hunter]] won, beating [[Jan Westergard]] in both games of the final, and [[Andy Klema]] took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22436-327951">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=327951#p327951 This weekend], Pistone84 (Michael Pistone), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194100/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22436.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Scholar's Books and Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts (played in the church hall down the street)<ref name="sf-21864-315327" />
* '''Dates:''' 16 August 2008<ref name="sf-21864-315327" />
* '''Time:''' pre-registration 11:30 am; start 12:00 pm<ref name="sf-21864-315327" />
* '''Format:''' six rounds of Swiss and an untimed final confrontation between the top two<ref name="sf-21864-315327" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $41 if pre-registered, $46 otherwise<ref name="sf-21864-315327" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Pistone]]<ref name="sf-21864-315327" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]<ref name="sf-22436-327951" />

== Organization ==

Pistone announced the event on 15 July 2008. Only the cash received went into the prize pool: $50 of it paid for the hall, the third-place player got the entry fee back, and the rest went 75% to first and 25% to second. The event was held together with the [[2008 Massachusetts State Championship|Massachusetts State Championship]], run by [[Casey Anis]] at the same location the next day.<ref name="sf-21864-315327" /> Pistone bought a bye to Day 2 of the World Championship for the event with his own money, so that it did not come out of the prize pool.<ref name="sf-21864-316140">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316140#p316140 Event Details], Pistone84 (Michael Pistone), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192534/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21864.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

Pistone posted the results on 19 August 2008:<ref name="sf-22436-327951" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Prize
|-
| 1 || [[Eric Hunter]] || $210
|-
| 2 || [[Jan Westergard]] || $70

The Day 2 bye went to [[Andy Klema]].<ref name="sf-22436-327951" /> The list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids that Cedric (simone89) posted gives it as "August 16th Pistone Mass High Stakes Mini Open Andy Klema".<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Cedric listed the players as Eric Hunter, Jan Westergard, the "Hollingworth Combo", Pistone, [[Steve Baroni|Baroni]], Andy Klema, [[Mike Gemme|Gemme]] and himself, and wrote that the decklists were not posted.<ref name="sf-22436-330033">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=330033#p330033 This weekend], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194100/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22436.html Internet Archive]</ref>
